description: Expand shared layout components (AdminTopBar with functional notifications dropdown, AdminSidebar with collapsible sections, breadcrumb integration) and create reusable admin UI components (summary cards, filter panels, action buttons, notification badges). These components are used across all admin pages
steps: Expand AdminTopBar in src/components/admin/layout/AdminTopBar.jsx: Add functional notifications dropdown with sample notifications (institution updates, user actions, system alerts), show unread count badge, make notifications dismissable, add 'Mark all as read' action, and ensure breadcrumb navigation displays current page hierarchy

Update AdminSidebar in src/components/admin/layout/AdminSidebar.jsx: Add collapsible navigation sections (Overview, Management, Operations, System), improve hover states, ensure active page highlighting works across all routes, add tooltip hints when collapsed

Create FilterPanel component in src/components/admin/ui/FilterPanel.jsx: Reusable filter bar with search input, status dropdown, role/type dropdowns, date range picker (UI only), and clear filters button. Used by Users, Institutions, Categories, Reports pages

Create SummaryCards component in src/components/admin/ui/SummaryCards.jsx: Grid of stat cards with icons, values, labels, optional trends, and color variants. Used by Dashboard, Users, Institutions, Reports pages
Create ActionButton component in src/components/admin/ui/ActionButton.jsx: Consistent styled button with icon, loading state, and variants (primary, secondary, danger). Used across all pages
Expand mockNotifications.js in src/data/mockNotifications.js: Add 15-20 sample admin notifications with timestamps, types (info, warning, alert), read/unread status, and action links

Add NotificationDropdown component in src/components/admin/ui/NotificationDropdown.jsx: Standalone dropdown component showing recent notifications, supporting mark as read, dismiss, and navigate to related pages
Update AdminLayout to pass notification state to AdminTopBar and make breadcrumb configurable per page
acceptance_criteria: AdminTopBar shows notification bell with red badge when unread notifications exist
Clicking notification bell opens dropdown with scrollable list of notifications, each dismissable
AdminSidebar sections collapse/expand smoothly when clicked, active page is highlighted with bg-white/20
FilterPanel component renders with all filter controls and emits onChange events
SummaryCards component displays 2, 3, or 4 cards per row based on props
ActionButton component renders with correct colors and icons for all variants
All layout changes preserve existing green branding and white card aesthetic
verification: Run npm run dev and navigate to /admin
Click notification bell - dropdown should open with sample notifications
Click sidebar section headers - sections should collapse/expand
Navigate to different admin pages - active page should be highlighted in sidebar
Inspect browser console - no errors should appear
